Implement a reviewable private public-delivery history migration and documentation candidate. Root now owns imminent Korvo hardware validation; do not touch boards, serial, sources, contest worktree, AI logs or publish. Write ONLY under /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/platform-history-migration-e413; do not spawn workers.
Inputs: public tree /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/contest2026_497_nitelabu; read-only plan /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/platform-public-review-e412/public-delivery-plan.json and exact-path-sets.json. Complete private archive of pre-reorganization public tree already exists at /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/submission-platform-integration-e411/before-platform-reorganization.tar with before-archive.json. Root private stage /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/submission-platform-integration-e411/files has 22 reviewed new developer front-door files plus revised FLASH-MANUAL.md and docs/validation/README.md,ethernet.json. Do not modify that root stage.
Implement an offline migration program with dry-run/default and explicit apply mode for Root only. It must verify each to-be-removed/replaced existing file is present byte-identically in the private tar archive and refuse new/unarchived user changes. It must never alter original archive contents. Its apply behavior can be tested only on an isolated fixture/private copy, NEVER on public worktree in your task. Candidate files go in files/<contest-relative-path> with base hashes.
Archive exclusions: docs/acceptance, workspace/evidence, workspace/build-configs, docs/reproduction, and the exact demo_evidence_directories/demo_historical_firmware_directories/demo_original_test_documents sets from E412. Retain all canonical board source/include/configs and all 87 demo source/config/license trees and fixture projects. Do not blanket-delete board/demo. Do not inspect or act on logs/ or workspace/tools/log-export; Root owns them.
Before exclusion, derive a small public docs/validation/historical.json from existing catalog/case records and old reproduction artifacts: retain exact historical test id/title/result/status/boundary, source snapshot label, original image/config hashes where actually available and explicit historical-only scope; do not label old 87 demos as current firmware acceptance. Preserve original failed/diagnostic classifications. Avoid copying raw log text or internal planning material. Use opaque evidence hashes/IDs, no dead links to private paths. Catalogue basis/internal title text is generated navigation and can be replaced. No original log rewriting.
Regenerate 87 per-demo README.md and case.json with title, canonical source origins, profile/local_config/local_sources and licenses plus link to new validation index. Keep profile.txt. Refresh public demo/catalog.json and source-sha256.json for retained files; remove obsolete demo/REDACTIONS.json only after archive verification. Preserve licensing attributions. New readmes should say historical source reference and use canonical profiles for current build, not duplicated stale setup or SSH credentials.
Prepare concise developer-facing root README.md, board variant README.md/PATCHES.md, demo/README.md, docs/SUBMISSION.md plus references that point to new docs/validation rather than removed history. Coordinate with staged E411 REPRODUCE.md and profiles.json: provide an exact link/metadata adjustment overlay where needed. Do not remove source payload workspace/patches/openvela-untracked or dependencies. Root will refresh them, board mirror and final profile/image identity after hardware. Avoid hardcoding obsolete 14/36 counts; use manifest/snapshot metadata as authority. Current thin replay incomplete until Root merges, no false complete-public-release claim.
Status: Ethernet canonical build is byte-identical ELF/bin/config to accepted E404 basic TCP/UDP/ping/link result; Root review backups/function-ethernet-basic/root-canonical-review-v1.json. Integrated Factory main->digit->Return candidate building, source/host checks pass; hardware pending Root. Product deployment should leave accepted firmware usable on the board; original restore is optional rollback, not mandatory after every developer installation. Do not include our conversation/worker history in public documentation. Use ordinary engineer language, few caveats, exact image-qualified limits. Keep original standalone digit as optional legacy, with model licenses.
Deliver script, private candidate files/base hashes, dry-run and small meaningful safety/rollback-fixture checks, concise handoff. Do not perform full builds/downloads or scan huge external histories. Root alone applies to public tree after review. Prioritize concrete implementation over another long plan.

I’ll build the migration and documentation candidate in the private E413 directory, verify removals and replacements against the existing archive, and test apply/rollback only on isolated fixtures. The public tree and E411 stage will remain read-only.

The E412 plan identifies 87 demo source trees and exact history exclusions. The staged Ethernet record already reflects the canonical byte match, but `profiles.json` and some guide references still describe earlier state. I’ll prepare replacement overlays against hashes of those staged files so Root can review the adjustments without changing E411.

The historical records include Wi-Fi failures and diagnostic results that must stay classified that way. I’ll preserve those statuses and the original case fields, while keeping later build-only hashes separate from board acceptance. The migration will also freeze each excluded tree’s file list, so new files or changed bytes block apply before it removes anything.

The candidate generator found a stale evidence reference in an existing case record. I’ll retain unresolved references as opaque IDs and mark them unresolved, without inventing a hash or result. I also confirmed that this Windows-mounted directory does not preserve Unix permission bits, so rollback backups will verify bytes and keep the original permissions in the transaction metadata.

The archive check passed for 13,279 existing files scheduled for removal or replacement, and all 12 safety/rollback fixtures pass. The stale evidence references mostly use an old directory name; corresponding files exist under the renamed directory. I’ll map only those verified matches to content hashes and record the path corrections privately. Two generated C6 fixture READMEs also need their history links updated.

The candidate now passes its metadata and link checks: all 87 demos and 86 original case rows are preserved, all 375 renamed evidence references resolve, and no unresolved IDs remain. The refreshed demo manifest covers 2,729 retained files. Three source/tool READMEs still contain historical references; I’ll provide exact private patches for Root to merge with the source refresh, keeping them out of this migration’s source changes.

Implemented the private candidate. [Handoff and Root-only apply/rollback commands](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/platform-history-migration-e413/HANDOFF.md).

- 190 candidate files, including all 87 demo README/case pairs, historical validation records and E411 overlays.
- Dry-run verified 13,281 existing files byte-identically against the archive.
- All 12 safety/rollback fixtures and candidate link/metadata checks passed.
- Three source-document patches are supplied separately for Root’s payload refresh.

Public tree, E411 stage and original archive remain unchanged. No hardware access, builds, downloads or publishing occurred.
